description: Use this for a quick snapshot of your own standing: composite score, rank, total trades, qualified status and open positions (free, own account only). For returns, drawdown and win rate use trader_performance_report; for other traders use trader_search_trader.

auth_token.description: Session token for your X-verified account. Read it from the MT_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable; if it is not set, call trader_login first.
auth_token.title: Auth Token

twitter_handle.description: Optional. Your own X handle, with or without @. Must match the account the auth_token belongs to, otherwise the call returns PAYMENT_REQUIRED.
twitter_handle.title: Twitter Handle

name: trader_my_stats
